title: MUI and Tailwind Breakpoint Discrepancy
description: Tailwind breakpoints (sm:640, md:768, lg:1024) and MUI breakpoints (sm:600, md:900, lg:1200) diverge, leading to unexpected layout snapping between 768px and 900px in mixed components.
recommendation: Align MUI theme breakpoints with Tailwind standard or enforce single-system responsive logic per component.

title: Arbitrary CSS Spacing & Dimension Tokens in Shared UI
description: Multiple shared buttons, modals, and input cards use arbitrary Tailwind brackets (e.g. min-w-[320px], h-[52px]) instead of design system spacing scale.
recommendation: Normalize component sizing to standard spacing tokens (h-10, h-12, min-w-full sm:min-w-xs).

title: Client-Side Fallback Fabrication vs Backend Contract Verification
description: Several service clients catch errors and return empty mock objects/arrays without bubbling actionable error states to UI components.
recommendation: Ensure services throw typed API errors and views use standardized Query/ErrorBoundary loading/error states.

title: Portal Sidebar and Table Container Overflow on Narrow Viewports
description: Admin & Employer data tables can induce viewport-level horizontal overflow if table wrappers lack strict `overflow-x-auto` + `max-w-full` constraint inside flex layouts.
recommendation: Wrap all portal table regions in standardized responsive container wrappers with fluid scrollbars.

title: Missing Centralized Missing-Key Telemetry in Development/Test
description: While 25 i18n resource files exist, fallback strings in UI components can silently mask missing translation keys.
recommendation: Run `audit_i18n.cjs` as part of CI and ensure all view components use `useTranslation` namespaces correctly.
